<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== COUNTESS TRUE PATH CENSUS 412 - THE MESH PATH READ FROM THE CHARACTER SOURCE ITSELF (Job 410 stands as the record: its census hunted the Countess at an assumed path and printed SM_Countess absent with zero material slots, while the registry holds forty Countess-named assets and the Paragon_Proto_Retarget asset exists with a Rig class missing line in its load log. The character code sets the mesh from the MannyMesh.Object reference in VEILCharacter.cpp, so the true path stands written in the source itself. This job prints the mesh assignment lines from VEILCharacter.cpp with line numbers, lists every Countess-named skeletal mesh in the registry with its path, loads the mesh at the code-named path or the closest registry match and prints each material slot with its material path or NONE plus the physics asset it carries, loads the retarget asset and prints its class state, and closes with two verdicts: MATERIALS STAND or MATERIALS MISSING at the true slot counts, and RETARGET CLASS with the loaded class or the missing class named from the load log. No edits anywhere.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'PHI GREY412 NAMED HOLD: EDITOR STILL STANDING AFTER THE 100 SECOND IN-JOB WAIT - no commandlet launched into the contention'; Write-Output 'JOB 412 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'PHI GREY412 EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: CHARACTER SOURCE MESH LINES ---'
$cppFiles = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -Filter 'VEILCharacter.cpp' -File
if (-not $cppFiles) { Write-Output 'NO VEILCHARACTER CPP FOUND' }
foreach ($f in $cppFiles) {
  Write-Output ("SOURCE FILE: " + $f.FullName)
  Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern 'MannyMesh|FObjectFinder|SkeletalMesh' | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($f.Name + ' ' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
}
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: REGISTRY SKELETAL LIST, LOAD, MATERIAL SLOTS, RETARGET ---'
$py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$out = "$base\Saved\phi_grey412.txt"
$py = $py.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$out'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_grey412.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_grey412.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\grey412.log"
if (Test-Path $out) { Get-Content $out | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO GREY412 OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\grey412.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: RETARGET LOAD LOG LINES ---'
$hits = @(Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\grey412.log" -Pattern 'Paragon_Proto_Retarget|Rig|Failed|Missing' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
Write-Output ("PHI GREY412 LOG HIT COUNT=" + $hits.Count)
$hits | Select-Object -First 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
$rigHit = $hits | Where-Object { $_.Line -match 'class \(Rig\) does not exist' } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($rigHit) { Write-Output 'PHI GREY412 RETARGET CLASS FROM LOG: Rig - class does not exist' }
Write-Output 'JOB 412 DONE'
```
